cc:Work.dc:title: Box - ABox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A simple Box
This box is kept simple on purpose. If you need more features have a look at the UniversalBox.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ABox --x 150 --y 80 --h 50 --outside 1 --bottom_edge F --Lid_style chest --Lid_handle knob --thickness 5 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes ABox --x --y --h --bottom_edge --Lid_style --Lid_handle --thickness --burn --reference --labels
